_comment: Martyr Lifegain (2026-11-10), Enduring Innocence's dies-return, reached the way a human can: Curious Farm Animals' sacrifice destroys our own (creature) Innocence through the '(may destroy)' dig. Innocence dies as a creature, so it returns to the battlefield as a NONcreature enchantment (the history line), not in the graveyard; the Farm's dies trigger gains 3. Innocence was summoning sick, so nothing attacks and no lifelink moves life.
